title: Bar Drop Gummy Bear 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Gummy Bear is a fun and intensely sweet confectionery-inspired blend that recreates a nostalgic childhood favourite. The profile features a mixed medley of bright fruit notes wrapped in a chewy, sugary base. The extra-concentrated flavouring amplifies the confectionery sweetness, ensuring the vibrant fruit and sugar elements are delivered with maximum impact, resulting in a satisfying and playful vape. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid is specifically designed for MTL/RDL vaping. When paired with stater vape kits and low-wattage tanks, it produces small vapour clouds alongside exceptional flavour clarity. The even consistency ensures optimal wicking and performance in MTL/RDL devices, providing a smooth and satisfying experience. The Bar Drop Shortfill collection takes the intensely concentrated flavour profiles typically found in "bar salt" ranges and presents them in a 50%-VG format. Supplied as 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 60ml bottle, there is space to add a single 10ml nicotine shot, allowing you to easily create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. This offers a cost-effective and highly flavoursome solution for sub-ohm vapers.
